response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now fluttering in a strange, discordant rhythm.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a stout and proud man in his late 40s, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But as he gazes out the window, his expression changes from regal to bewildered.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
What sorcery is this? The colors of our banners, once so bold and vibrant, now seem... faded.

LORD THORNE
Your Majesty, it is but the natural wear of time. The sun beats down upon our flags, causing them to fade.

KING ARIN
(skeptical)
I have ordered the royal heralds to re-dye the banners, but they return with a strange, synthetic material that seems to shift and writhe in the light.

CUT TO:

INT. ROYAL WORKSHOP - DAY

The royal heralds, led by the hapless SERGEANT PATEL, are frantically trying to create a new banner. They are surrounded by strange, glowing fabrics and peculiar machinery.

SERGEANT PATEL
(to the heralds)
We must create a banner that captures the essence of our kingdom! Something that will make the people proud!

HERALD 1
(excitedly)
I have it! We can use this new, synthetic material! It's got a... a... (consults a small, leather-bound book)...a "neon" quality to it!

KING ARIN
(approvingly)
Very well, let us see what you have created.

The heralds present the king with a banner that seems to pulse with an otherworldly energy. The colors are a jarring mix of pastel hues and neon pink, and the fabric seems to ripple and distort in the light.

KING ARIN
(impressed)
This is... different. But I like it.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The banner is raised high above the castle walls, and the people of the kingdom gather to marvel at its strange beauty. But as they gaze upon the banner, they begin to feel a creeping sense of unease.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arin sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But as he gazes out the window, his expression changes from regal to concerned.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
I fear we have made a mistake. This... this "proto-vaporwave" aesthetic is not what our people need.

LORD THORNE
(nervously)
But, Your Majesty, it is a symbol of our kingdom's... forward-thinking nature.

KING ARIN
(firmly)
I will not be swayed. We must return to our traditional ways, lest we risk losing our very identity.

FADE TO BLACK.

Note: I've tried to incorporate elements of vaporwave into the screenplay, such as the use of pastel colors, neon lights, and synthetic materials. I've also tried to create a sense of unease and discomfort among the characters, as they struggle to adapt to this new aesthetic.
